Read-only startup verification reconstructs the pending request without completed-record or checkpoint credit. It verifies historical choices, source, all retained checkpoints, cumulative receipts, exact current inventory and current/future capacity, then repeats locks, guards, file census and free-space checks.

Low-space and source-change failures before/after request creation preserve existing evidence, retain the attempted/partial request where applicable, publish failure without a successful receipt and reject retry. The fixture retains all six selected checkpoint files; no fresh weights exist.
